result:
Perfect! All tests now pass. 

**The bug was in `/tmp/tacet-bench.HL35A2/project/tally/invoice.py` line 42:**

The `discount()` method was checking `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` but should have been `if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:` because the bulk discount should start **at** 10 units, not after 10 units.

The fix changed the comparison operator from `>` to `>=`, so now when an invoice has exactly 10 units (meeting the bulk order threshold), the 5% discount is correctly applied.
